semantics.address: Full absolute address, without a documented first-error/last-error, latch-stability or multi-error ordering guarantee. Never dereferenced by this HAL.
semantics.checking: Always enabled at power-up, not user-configurable; EN where present is a read-only status bit, not a writable parity control.
semantics.writes: CPU writes generate one parity bit per byte; a mismatch on reading latches ISR.PARITY and requests the shared IRQ if IER.PARITY is enabled.
semantics.acknowledgment: ICR.PARITY is R1W0, zero clears and one does nothing. Reserved bits keep zero reset values. Acknowledgment repairs no RAM.
semantics.irq: FLASHRAM or FLASH_RAM IRQ3 is shared with FLASH. Masking or clearing RAM does not mask or clear FLASH or NVIC pending state.
semantics.initialization: No RAM initialization/scrub/reset/injection command is documented. HAL never reads or writes SRAM contents, including stack, heap, vector table, or executable RAM. Boot-time Rust data initialization remains the startup runtime responsibility.
semantics.faults: Misaligned RAM accesses are documented as HardFault; parity is documented as a flag plus optional IRQ. No automatic ECC correction, parity HardFault, reset, lossless event queue or recoverability guarantee is claimed.

field_access_projection.basis: Narrow read-only field restrictions for mixed RW registers; syntax-tree removal of exactly one setter with its getter retained; generic raw PAC register escape hatches retain their usual low-level responsibilities.
